prompts.text: Wide ambient strings over a slow sea swell, wind in the rigging, modern indie game score, hopeful
Four rising notes on solo violin, then the orchestra taking them up, scarlet sails filling at dawn
Creaking timber and rope textures turned into soft percussion, a ship working under sail
Low cello pulse like a hull rising and falling, steady, determined
Sea shanty melody slowed down on a lone concertina, night watch, lanterns
Gypsy violin, warm and free, a musician playing on deck at night
Storm: driving low strings and timpani, spray and wind, tense but not dark
Shimmering harp and celesta, sun on the water, calm sailing
Full romantic orchestra swelling, horns and strings, arrival, joy
Minimal piano and soft synth pad, a young man reading a letter in a quiet harbour
Fiddles tuning, a few bars tried and dropped, scissors and silk rustle, night in port
Brass band far away on a steamer's deck, faint and festive
Airy wordless choir on the wind, the open sea at dawn
Rhythmic bowed bass and handclaps, a crew hauling sails up together
Lonely flute over open fifths, the mast top, the horizon all round
Glassy pads and slow guitar harmonics, moonlit deck, two people at the rail
Accordion waltz at night, an old cask opened, wine for paradise
Steady marimba ostinato with strings, holding the course straight
Deep foghorn-like synth swells, grey calm port morning
